what: One-machine node-to-node A/B at a 1408x768 canvas: the official example's path (its own prepare_input_tensor + the stock pipeline) against this repo's node path (comfyui/nodes.py prep + the sm89 ops pack).
method: same 85-frame 352x192 clip (F=89, 1 tile), one RTX 4090 container, one process per arm, prep and render timed separately; ops arm runs flashvsr_sm89_ops.enable(pipe).
note: The 1.30x headline in README is the pipeline-only ratio (pr2_harness/headtohead JSONs). Counting the input preparation, which both paths run per request, moves it to 1.34x on this run.
